properties.name: educloud.common.environment
properties.description: Redis ID lease namespace for one deployment environment; this is not a tenant identifier.

properties.name: educloud.common.id.enabled
properties.description: Whether Redis-backed distributed identifier generation is enabled.

properties.name: educloud.common.id.lease-ttl
properties.description: Redis worker lease time to live.

properties.name: educloud.common.id.renewal-interval
properties.description: Worker lease renewal interval; it must be less than the lease TTL.

properties.name: educloud.common.id.clock-backward-tolerance
properties.description: Maximum wall-clock rollback that identifier generation may wait through.
